Chest Institute, G.B. government_all.year_label: BULLETIN OF INFORMATION-2026-27 … FOR THE ACADEMIC SESSION 2026-27
government_all.quote: 7.3 … submit the fee as per following: (i) 1st year Annual Fee of Rs. 19,500/- … 1. Tuition Fee 13000 2. University Student Welfare Fund* 300 3. University Development Fund* 1750 4. University Facilities and Services Charges* 1750 5. Economically Weaker Section Support University Fund* 300 6. Faculty Management Fee (Annual) 2400 Total 19,500

fees.seat_as_printed: Annual Fee (Total, of which Tuition Fee 13000)

government_all.notes: Per year: the same Rs. 19,500/- is due for 2nd and 3rd year 'WITHIN FIRST MONTH OF THE STARTING OF RESPECTIVE ACADEMIC SESSION'. Marked '* The Fee mentioned above may change in accordance with the directions of the competent authority'; p.21 adds 'The fee mentioned above is under review and may change.' Registration fee (non-refundable) Rs. 3,000/- per course (SC/ST/PwBD Rs. 2,000/-). Security deposit Rs 25,000/- at joining (refunded on completion/leaving). Surety bond Rs. 10.00 lacs. This is the university's fee paid on the FMSc portal; hostel or any institution-level charges are not in the bulletin.

government_all.scope: GGSIPU-affiliated medical colleges in Delhi (IP quota institutes): Vardhman Mahavir Medical College & Safdarjung Hospital, ABVIMS & Dr RML Hospital, ESI-PGIMSR Basaidarapur, Chacha Nehru Bal Chikitsalaya
government_all.year_label: ADMISSION BROCHURE FOR MASTER's PROGRAMMES 2026-27 — CHAPTER 14: FEE STRUCTURE (brochure p.161)
government_all.quote: Affiliated Colleges/ Institutions located in Delhi | University Charges per year: (a) Rs. 20,000/- (for all the programmes except Medical Colleges) (b) Rs. 25,000/- (only for Medical Colleges) | Security Deposit onetime payment (refundable) Rs. 10,000/- | Alumni Contribution Fund (Onetime payment) Rs. 2,000/- … A. Examination Fee @ Rs. 3,000/- per student/ per annum and Innovation & Incubation Fee of Rs. 500/- per student/ per annum … B. … Rs. 1,000/- (Non Refundable) as 'Student Welfare Activity Fee' Per Annum.

fees.seat_as_printed: University Charges per year — Rs. 25,000/- (only for Medical Colleges)

government_all.notes: PARTIAL — university charges only, 'In addition to the fee as notified by DHE'. The institutes' own tuition is not printed in ch14 (its tables are for the University School of Studies); item 3 says fees of affiliated colleges for 2026-27 'to be fixed by State Fee Regulatory Committee shall be notified by the University in due course' — that refers to self-financing institutes. Do not treat Rs. 25,000 as the whole fee for these four government institutes.
